title: The Fragrant Highland Wind (Ka Lyer Ka Dang Sieng)
khasi_title: Ka Lyer Ka Dang Sieng ha ki Lum
cultural_context: Celebrates the fresh, aromatic fragrance of the Khasi mountain air wafting sweet scents of highland pine needles, wild betel leaves, and blooming tree orchids. Evokes the ancient journeys of ancestors traversing the paved stone trails between Sohra, Pynursla, and Dawki along the southern escarpment.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ki tnum ba jrong ka lyer ka dang sieng,
Ka iathuh ia ka nam jong ka Ri ba pyngngad;
Ka sieng u dieng kseh, ka sieng u tiew-khlaw,
Ka pynim ia ka dohnud ba thait ha lynti!

Ha ki lynti-maw ba la tei ki tymmen,
Ngi iaid da ka kmen ryngkat ka sur rwai;
Ka lyer ka dang beh, ka sngi ka dang phyrnai,
Ka Ri Khasi kan neh ha ka suk ba kynjai!
lyrics_english:
Across the lofty ridges the wind still wafts sweet fragrance,
Proclaiming the glory of our cool, blessed homeland;
Scent of green highland pines, scent of wild mountain orchids,
Reviving the weary heart along the rugged trail!

Along ancient paved stone paths constructed by our ancestors,
We journey with rejoicing and songs upon our lips;
The mountain breeze still blows, the sun shines bright,
The Khasi homeland shall abide in peaceful serenity!

stanzas.title: Ka Lyer ba Dang Sieng (The Scented Wind)
stanzas.khasi:
Ha ki tnum ba jrong ka lyer ka dang sieng,
Ka iathuh ia ka nam jong ka Ri ba pyngngad;
Ka sieng u dieng kseh, ka sieng u tiew-khlaw,
Ka pynim ia ka dohnud ba thait ha lynti!
stanzas.english: Across lofty ridges winds blow fragrant, telling of our cool land; scented with pine and wild orchid, reviving weary travelers on the trail!

stanzas.title: Ki Lynti-Maw Mynhyndai (Ancient Stone Trails)
stanzas.khasi:
Ha ki lynti-maw ba la tei ki tymmen,
Ngi iaid da ka kmen ryngkat ka sur rwai;
Ka lyer ka dang beh, ka sngi ka dang phyrnai,
Ka Ri Khasi kan neh ha ka suk ba kynjai!
stanzas.english: Along stone paths paved by ancestors, we march joyful with song; breezes blow and the sun gleams, Khasi land endures in serene peace!

vocabulary.lyer-sieng: Aromatic, fragrance-bearing breeze carrying mountain floral scents
vocabulary.tiew-khlaw: Wild uncultivated jungle flower or epiphytic mountain orchid
vocabulary.lynti-maw: Ancient stone-paved highland trading trails traversing valleys and root bridges
vocabulary.pynim dohnud: To revive, invigorate, and refresh the weary heart and spirit
